style="whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontColor=#243247;text;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#5B45A0;fontStyle=0;html=1;" value="Dashed purple = mail agent, deployed separately. div.div: Dashed = browser webmail, deployed separately from the mail system. The browser calls the JMAP API directly (bearer token, CORS for the webmail origin); the webmail server only exchanges OAuth codes / refresh tokens with Cognito and has no AWS mailbox, index or secret grants. ECR supplies its container image.

div.div: Dashed purple = mail agent, deployed separately. It reaches mail only through the JMAP API with the owner's delegated token from AgentCore Identity; it has no IAM access to the mail bucket, tables or search index. Models are reached through OpenRouter (key in Secrets Manager), so prompt excerpts of mail leave AWS. Its ECR image, agent DynamoDB table (triage rows, digest cursor, send markers) and CloudWatch telemetry are omitted.
